intelligence_layer.title: The new intelligence layer
intelligence_layer.content:
AI is rapidly becoming the primary way clients access intelligence and insights. At Aurora, we've invested heavily in that future, building APIs, EOS AI and Aurora EOS MCP with support from more than 100 specialists across data, engineering, modelling and product teams.

Our goal is simple: bring Aurora's intelligence directly into the tools clients use every day.

intelligence_layer.highlight_text: As the energy industry enters a new intelligence era, EOS MCP extends Aurora's intelligence beyond the EOS platform, enabling seamless integration with AI-driven research and analysis workflows.

what_is_mcp.definition: MCP stands for Model Context Protocol—an open standard that lets AI models query live, structured data sources in real time, without manual data export.
what_is_mcp.description: In practice, EOS MCP delivers Aurora's market intelligence directly into tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, so users can access trusted data and insights wherever analysis happens.

does.text: Allows AI agents to dynamically interact and reason with Aurora data
Grounds analysis in trusted, traceable Aurora sources

doesnt.text: Access or use data it shouldn't

best_practices.title: Tips for effective use of EOS MCP

items.title: Tell your AI assistant when to use EOS MCP
items.description: Naming the tool up front keeps your assistant grounded in Aurora data instead of guessing from general knowledge.
items.benefit: keeps answers specific and saves tokens

quotes.quote: You can invoke single tools too: “Using the Aurora content tools only, comment on battery profitability under the Central scenario.”

items.title: Don't stop at a single question
items.description: Specify the analysis, markets, comparisons, sources, and final format in one go—let the assistant chain the steps.
items.benefit: complex analysis becomes one structured workflow, compressing days of work into minutes
items.say_label: One prompt, a full IC report

quotes.quote: “Latest flex scenarios, seven markets in one confidential HTML report, each benchmarked against GB, with web research on grid connection status folded into a ‘probability of success’ metric.”

items.note: Your tool choice shows here: Claude runs the prompt step by step end-to-end, where some assistants stall partway and ask which scenario to use.

items.title: Save your preferred workflows as skills
items.description: Turn a prompt you've refined into a reusable prompt file (skill.md) so the same analysis runs the same way every time.

quotes.quote: You build a “What happened last quarter to batteries across six European markets” newsletter with Claude and EOS MCP, iterating until structure, detail, citations and tone are right.

items.note: Save it as a skill—the same report lands every quarter, without rebuilding the prompt.

items.question: Is EOS MCP included in my subscription?
items.answer: Yes. EOS MCP is included with your subscription and does not require an additional add-on.

items.question: Which AI tools can connect to EOS MCP?
items.answer: Any AI application, including in-house solutions, can connect if it supports MCP and Dynamic Client Registration.

items.question: What's the difference between using an AI assistant directly and using EOS MCP?
items.answer: EOS MCP enables your AI assistant to access Aurora data and analytics directly within your workflow.

items.question: How does EOS MCP find the right data?
items.answer: EOS MCP automatically selects relevant datasets, or you can specify a dataset directly in your prompt.

items.question: Can I ask my AI to combine information from EOS MCP with my other data sources such as SharePoint documents, other MCPs, and internet search?
items.answer: Yes. An agentic AI such as Claude and ChatGPT is able to orchestrate workflows between multiple MCP connectors and data sources. EOS MCP enables you to bring Aurora into your professional context without switching between browser tabs.

items.question: Which markets and datasets are available?
items.answer: EOS MCP provides access to the products, datasets and geographies included in your subscription.

items.question: Can EOS MCP link me to the source data and reports?
items.answer: Yes. EOS MCP can provide direct links to the underlying reports and datasets.

items.question: Are prompts shared with Aurora?
items.answer: No. Aurora does not see your prompts; we only see MCP tool calls and the parameters passed to those tools.

items.question: Does EOS MCP reduce token usage?
items.answer: Typically, yes. EOS MCP retrieves only the information needed for a task, rather than processing large volumes of files.

items.question: Where can I find MCP skills?
items.answer: Skills and installation instructions are available in the EOS MCP documentation.
